newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline ends slightly lower, supplies ample.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline ends slightly lower, supplies ample.

text.p: NWE gasoline prices ended slightly lower on Monday, lagging the selloff in futures but still pressured by ample local supplies, traders said.
A 60,000 tonne cargo of blending material was still available for the States at an offer better than April NYMEX gasoline futures minus six cents a gallon, traders confirmed.
The arbitrage was still mostly shut for 30,000 tonne vessels and even for some larger tankers, and that extra material was expected to weigh on the ARA or possibly find a home in the Med.
Eurograde barges for early March delivery fell $1 to $200/$201 fob ARA with April barrels at $202/$204.
Regular unleaded barges were assessed $5 lower at $195/$196 for early March.
"For mogas there is plenty of material in ARA...The Med is tight," said one trader in Germany. He said there was buying interest for a 10,000 tonne cargo into Hamburg.
